Subject: MSA + Order Form — clauses capture & priority lanes

Hi Amanda / FinMarker contracts team,

Thanks for the quick signal on moving forward. To keep our review tight and avoid back-and-forth, I've attached a short party info sheet and our latest redline template. Two asks to help us triage: 

1) Please confirm your counterparty contacts for: legal (primary), billing, and procurement (name + email + phone).

2) Return redlines using tracked changes against Redline_Template_v2.docx if possible. If you prefer a marked-up PDF, call that out and we'll accept it.

3) To speed prioritization, can you flag any changes by priority: P0 (deal-blocker), P1 (negotiable but important), P2 (cosmetic). We will treat P0 items as highest urgency and route to our leadership if needed.

For example, items we expect to see flagged as P0: indemnity, data handling/security obligations, and termination for convenience/billing liability. If you want, include brief rationale lines next to the redline.

Target turnaround from your side: 3 business days. We can compress if you want a live call.

Attachments: Redline_Template_v2.docx; Party_Info_Sheet.xlsx

Thanks — I’ll loop in Contracts and Legal on our side once we have your redlines.

— Vanessa Ortiz

Vanessa, thanks — we received the template. Attaching our party sheet and our tracked changes against your template (FinMarker_Redlines.docx; FinMarker_PartyInfo.xlsx).

Quick notes up front to help with triage:
- We flagged indemnity (Section 9) as P0. Our legal is proposing mutual indemnity and a cap equal to the greater of 3x paid fees or $1M (we included both options in the redline).
- Data residency language: P1 — internal compliance prefers EU-data carve for some customers; will propose narrow language.
- Service credits: P1 — want a clearer SLA ladder for availability.

We can do a 30-minute sync tomorrow morning PT if that helps — Amanda or I can be on the call.

Laura / Marissa — forwarding FinMarker's redlines and party sheet (attached). Amanda flagged indemnity as a P0 and offered two cap options; data residency and SLA language are P1s.

Proposed internal plan:
- Laura, can you pick up a clause-by-clause mapping? Please create a two-column spreadsheet: Clause / FinMarker ask + our recommended position + fallback position. Mark anything we should escalate to Sales/GC as "escalate".
- Marissa, please capture commercial fallbacks for billing/termination: specific ask is whether we can accept 3x ARR or $1M cap — we should run economics on both and recommend which to offer based on ARR thresholds.
- I’ll schedule a 30-min sync with Amanda for tomorrow 10:00 PT to walk P0s only. If either of you cannot make that time, shout and I’ll move it.

A couple of immediate thoughts:
- Indemnity: prefer mutual indemnity; we should not offer an unlimited uninsured exposure. Recommend struggling for a dollar cap tied to ARR tiers and add carveouts for Third Party Claims arising from our Services (not customer data misuse).
- Termination: avoid a long tail invoicing exposure — propose pro-rated refund for unused prepaid credits and a maximum 60-day invoice exposure post-termination.

I'll attach FinMarker material to the calendar invite.

— Vanessa
